files.name: Pip the Frog — Character Sheet V2
files.meta: 2400x1750 PNG · 4 turnaround views · 8 expressions · rig map
files.note: Design refinement V2: one 3D-projected vector model at four yaws. 8 facial expressions off 14 channels. Awaiting visual approval.

files.name: Pip the Frog - rig v2 key frames
files.note: Six key frames from the corrected animation.

files.name: Pip the Frog - rig v2 corrected (blink + wave + elbow)
files.note: Joint fixes: eyelid clip on an untransformed parent, lid travel 48% so a white crescent and the eye ring survive, limbs bridged into the torso and drawn behind it, shoulder/hip pivots inside the body, arm split into upper+forearm for a gentle elbow. 5 exact palette colours.

files.name: Pip the Frog - rig diagnostic joints
files.note: Diagnostic render of the corrected rig: arm/hip pivots inside the torso, elbow cut lines, eyelid clip circles, limb bounds.

files.name: Pip the Frog - V4 vector (ChatGPT art traced)
files.note: ChatGPT-generated art snapped to a 5-colour palette and auto-traced with vtracer. Seam between head and torso repaired, pupils recoloured to near-black.

files.name: Pip the Frog - V4 rig test (blink + wave)
files.note: Rig test on the traced V4 art. Blink from clipped lids, arm wave by rotation with a shoulder tuck behind the torso. Frames stepped deterministically.

files.name: Pip the Frog - V4 rig parts
files.note: Six separately addressable parts: head, body, arm_l, arm_r, leg_l, leg_r. Each fully outlined so limbs can rotate without revealing holes.

files.name: Pip the Frog - V4 animation key frames
files.note: Six key frames from the rig test: rest, blink closing, blink closed, arm swinging up, wave peak, second blink.

files.name: Pip the Frog - V3 lily pad
files.note: Pip V3 sitting naturally on his lily pad. Same byte-identical markup as the front view.

files.name: Pip the Frog - V3 front
files.note: Pip V3 character front view. Rendered from reference-measured silhouette, exact stroked outline.

files.name: Pip the Frog — Character Sheet v1
files.note: Turnaround (front / three-quarter / side / back) plus neutral, happy, sad and surprised busts. Drawn in code from the approved design sheet: fills only inside one filtered group, single union outline, no bitmap. Palette sampled from the reference swatches.
